title: Drive Assist Plus and related plus points
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention Drive Assist Plus and a few unrelated vehicle advantages, with praise for comfort, navigation, fuel economy, and driver assistance but one clear complaint about drive assist issues and many fragments too vague or incomplete to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise drive assist along with comfort, navigation, cornering feel, and fuel economy as notable benefits.

negative.summary: One negative review reports issues with drive assist mode alongside app, software upgrade, and phone connection problems.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention Drive Assist Plus, monitoring cameras, or generic 'plus' comments, but several are too brief or context-limited to assign a clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: This topic mixes Drive Assist Plus comments with unrelated uses of 'plus' such as fuel economy, cameras, sunroof, and generic phrasing.
Many fragments are extremely short or lack enough context to determine clear sentiment.
The examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of overall owner experience.
